The Delta Delta Chapter of Psi Upsilon Fraternity received nationwide recognition when Brother Tom
Basnight, '66, represented Williams on the G.E. College Bowl. The Williams team retired after five
weeks as undefeated champions. When asked what his extra-curricular activities were, Tom explained
that he served as pledgemaster to the Delta Delta Chapter of Psi Upsilon, was a member of the
varsity wrestling team, and was an enthusiastic member of the Delta Delta Motorcycle Club. In
addition to elevating the stature of Williams College and Psi U, he has taken a position with the
Ford Motor Company in industrial relations.
